title: One line, and four strands of the same surname that no record joins to it
alt: Where each of these Falco came from and where each of them went — one line and the four strands of the same surname that no record joins to it

bands.title: Out of Arienzo, by marriage
spine: Seven generations, most of them on one street — strada Camellara.
Generation eight was born here because generation seven married an Annecchino of Forchia. A marriage moved a family that had not moved in seven generations.
Where Carmine Falco married Francesca Zampiello of Arpaia.
The ss SYDNEY of the Lauro Lines, Genoa to Brisbane, arrived 26 March 1964.
fan: Five Falco graves in the Catholic cemetery at Nudgee, Brisbane.

bands.title: Out of Paolisi, into Arienzo
spine: «infanti nato ex FRANCISCO FALCO CASALIS PAULISII» — the baptism states his origin outright. It is the earliest Arienzo Falco household with a stated place of origin.
Giuseppe, baptised at Sant'Andrea in July 1714.
A son whose given name will not read as either Matteo or Martino.
Domenico, baptised February 1726 — the last of them.
fan: Twelve years before Matteo's generation, and nothing whatever joins it to this line. It would be a satisfying answer to where the family came from, which is exactly why it is drawn apart.

bands.title: The Falco of San Felice a Cancello
spine: «ho battezzato la figlia di TOMASO FALCO e MARTA MARA coniugi … e li ho imposto nome LUCRETIA» — written in Italian, not Latin. The earliest Falco entry this archive holds anywhere.
SEBASTIANO FALCO and his son LUIGI, eighteen, both SAPUNARO — soap-makers — of strada Croce di San Felice, with COLOMBA MONTEFUSCO, fifty-five, filatrice.
Luigi Falco marries at Arienzo as a minor, assisted by both parents. It is the only crossing between the two towns in the Falco name.
fan: Generation four's wife was born at San Felice a Cancello three years later, on 24 February 1818, at the Massaria delle Fosse. THE SAME TOWN IS NOT A CONNECTION. Nothing joins the soap-makers to her or to this line.

bands.title: The gentry Falco of Arienzo
spine: DON FRANCESCO FALCO, PROPRIETARIO, and DONNA MADDALENA SICILIANO — her name read from the image on 20 September 2026 and new to this archive.
«è morta nel Monastero d'AVE GRATIA PLENA, DONNA RAFFAELA DE' FALCO, d'anni SESSANTASETTE … di professione MONACA, figlia di DON FRANCESCO FALCO Defunto, di professione PROPRIETARIO».
fan: A landowner and his daughter, a nun dead at sixty-seven. Ours are contadini and braccianti. Plainly a different household living elsewhere in the same town.

bands.title: The Falco of the valle Caudina
spine: Four hundred and six Falco harvested from the Paolisi registers. All of them reach the register and the search index; not one of them is claimed as kin.
Three hundred and ten more. Deciding whether any of these belongs to this family is a reading job on a thousand rows that has never been started.
fan: Giving them a household would be a claim, not a promotion. They are searchable and they are unjoined, and that is the honest state of them.
